name: centrale-rischi-review
description: Reviewable Centrale Rischi exposure analysis for Vera from the official digital PDF or confirmed CSV and Excel exports.

interface.shortDescription: Analyse an official Centrale Rischi report.
interface.longDescription: Vera normalizes the official digital Centrale Rischi PDF or inventories a supplied CSV or Excel export, requires reviewed field and value mappings, and then calculates short-, medium- and long-term exposures, guarantees, overruns, concentration, available resources and source-supported KPIs. Missing financial-statement ratios and prejudicial evidence remain explicitly unavailable. Calculated facts, model-led interpretation and professional approval remain separate.
defaultPrompt: Analyse this Centrale Rischi PDF or export and separate short-, medium- and long-term exposures.
List guarantees, overruns and prejudicial events supported by this report.
Prepare a reviewable Centrale Rischi KPI pack without inventing financial-statement ratios.
